purpose: Static educational tubarium reconstruction; independent acceptance/publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, original directed topology/winding, source reopen, two real separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, transformed counts/dimensions, true-solid contacts and whole-scene exposure.

Retain cone and compound tube material. Correct concept too-wide sparse basket gaps to much denser narrow meshes, include true dichotomy. Tube-mouth count48 is a readable artistic sampling of many zooidal tubes, not claim of exact biology. Minimal truncated proximal opening is uncertainty boundary, not invented naturally ring-shaped holdfast. Personally inspect eight final512px views and lossless sheet; same-subject details for microscopic apertures.

A three-dimensional flared open cone of dichotomously branching compound ropy stipes with16→32→64 selected stipe counts. Actual slender thecal bridges connect adjacent stipes at irregular oblique angles, not a generic smooth-stick Rhabdinopora mesh or solid web. Ropy compound stipe relief is integral multi-lobed/twisting tube surface, with48 selected short ventral/lateral free thecal apertures. Apertures have actual recessed lumens, not colored points. Proximal attachment is UNKNOWN and not invented; cone has an honestly bounded open proximal center, no holdfast, root or base. Mature colony continuation and exact cone angle are reconstructive. Silurian Rochester Shale D.retiforme type specimens. Maletz2019 revised Acanthograptidae diagnosis. Reconstructed tubarium, not claim of exact type fossil geometry. Source specimens flattened/incomplete, so artistic30mm height and40mm diameter are an illustrative colony scale; original40×50mm/120×130mm preservation extents not forced to living bounds.
Complete original freeze, payload, dependency closure and diagnostic exact selected counts. No arbitrary exposure-fraction gate.
Exact GLB through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Unrun hardware GPU evidence stays unknown. CPU images never substitute.
Unrun intended composed-scene evidence stays unknown.
